technology_name: Raw Banana Composite Mix Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for low-glycemic functional foods for diabetes management using value-added banana products.
description: Processes for the development of a raw banana composite mix. The technology utilizes green banana pulp, which contains 70-80% starch, processed using milling, boiling, drying, and mixing equipment to create functional foods.
applications: Production of low-glycemic clinical nutrition foods , Manufacturing of specialized diabetic-friendly meal mixes , Processing of value-added functional green banana flours , Formulation of therapeutic therapeutic-grade food bases
